baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ... يَبْخَلُ عَن نَفْسِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The call inclines the hearer toward letting wealth go out through a traversable path; the threefold withholding closes that outlet, so the blockage terminates at the withholder's own self.

activation_trace.role: Calling as verbal inclination supplies the directed summons that initiates the movement.
The literal outgoing of wealth supplies the material transfer being requested.
A tunnel with an exit makes expenditure legible as opening a passage rather than merely losing an object.
The extended traversable road gives the outgoing wealth a directed course.
Wrongful retention, repeated three times, functions as closure of the requested passage.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks for a charitable transfer and censures refusal.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a flow test: a called person either opens possessions into God's path or makes himself the endpoint of the blockage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine self-sufficiency and human need reverse the apparent direction of loss: withholding cannot preserve anything from a needy God, but deprives the withholder's own concrete self of what the expenditure would sustain.

activation_trace.role: Retention of what should not be held back supplies the mistaken protective act.
The self as the thing's own identity fixes the real recipient of the withholding's harm.
Freedom from need removes divine acquisition as the purpose of expenditure.
Sufficiency and adequacy make God the sustaining term rather than a deficient beneficiary.
Need and lack locate dependency on the human side of the exchange.

changed_reading.before: Keeping wealth appears to conserve the owner's resources against an external claim.
changed_reading.after: Keeping wealth is self-deprivation because the claimant lacks nothing while the owner remains constitutively dependent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning away vacates both proximity and charge; substitution then places another collective into the standing role, with non-likeness marking that succession need not reproduce the present collective's conduct.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the vacancy that makes succession possible.
Taking charge supplies the positive office whose abandonment matters.
One party standing in another's place supplies literal succession.
A human collective supplies the social bearer of the replacement.
Guardianship and sustained care specify the function for which a collective can stand.
Otherness and contrast prevent replacement from being mere duplication.
Likeness supplies the expressly negated reproduction of the outgoing group.

changed_reading.before: The ending threatens one population with another population.
changed_reading.after: The ending treats communal service as a replaceable office: withdrawal vacates it, another collective assumes it, and succession changes the operative pattern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ... لَا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing cluster permits two coexisting senses of replacement: a new bearer enters the old place, yet the form of performance itself changes, so non-likeness can concern method as well as identity.

activation_trace.role: Changing a thing's form without requiring a new substance supplies transformation within succession.
Alteration or exchange supplies a changed mode, not only a different owner.
Imitation and following a model supply the behavioral pattern that the negation refuses to preserve.

changed_reading.before: Different people will do what the present people would not do.
changed_reading.after: Replacement may alter both who carries the task and the inherited template by which the task is carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated obstruction from God's path and the later prohibition on nullifying works turn the focus withholding into the inward form of the surah's earlier blockage: wealth does not enter the path, and the obstruction rebounds as loss of the withholder's own effective action.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside and diverting supplies the opening instance of active path obstruction.
The repeated diversion near the close makes path blockage a framing action rather than an isolated offense.
Making something void supplies the nearby consequence against which the focus's self-directed withholding is read.
The outlet image turns spending into the positive inverse of diversion and blockage.
Retention supplies the inwardly localized obstruction at the focus.

structural_cues: The same path phrase stands beside صَدُّ near the surah's opening and near its close, while the focus places الإنفاق in that path.
The move from blocking others to withholding against oneself gives the framing repetition a directional reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated path-diversion, voided works, and self-directed withholding; I infer that blocked circulation causes loss of one's own effective participation. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral failures without a single flow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Withholding is one private failure among the surah's public oppositions.
changed_reading.after: Withholding is public path-obstruction folded inward: the person bars his own action from the route he was called to enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding conditional supplies a pressure sequence: exhaustive asking produces withholding and brings concealed rancor out. The focus then repeats withholding three times, converting the spending call into a disclosure event that makes latent attachments behaviorally visible.

activation_trace.role: Pressing a request exhaustively supplies the stress condition under which the response is exposed.
The predicted withholding supplies the behavior elicited by pressure immediately before the focus.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the diagnostic result of the pressured request.
The focus's threefold repetition holds the newly exposed response under sustained attention.
What is inwardly intended or held in mind supplies the latent interior whose orientation becomes readable through withholding.

structural_cues: 47:37 and 47:38 are a conditional prediction followed immediately by an actual call, joined by the repeated root ب خ ل.
The branchless أَضْغَانَكُمْ in 47:37 is used only as the packet's structural name for what the خروج reveals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, predicted withholding, and emergence from concealment; I infer that the focus call operationalizes that diagnostic and exposes attachment. A live alternative is that 47:37 merely limits the demand and 47:38 returns to ordinary exhortation.

changed_reading.before: The focus identifies stingy members of the audience.
changed_reading.after: The focus performs a stress test: the response to being asked makes a previously latent allegiance to possessions observable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence promises that works will not be docked, promises earned recompense, and says their wealth is not being requested, before naming a call to spend. This separates divine extraction from human expenditure and sharpens the focus reversal: refusal creates the only deficit, and it belongs to the refuser.

activation_trace.role: A shortfall that strips a right or work supplies the expressly negated divine deduction.
Recompense for work supplies credit flowing toward the audience rather than revenue flowing toward God.
Request and demand supply the explicitly denied taking of their wealth.
Divine adequacy explains why the call cannot be read as filling a divine lack.
Human need relocates the balance-sheet deficit to those being addressed.

structural_cues: 47:35-38 moves from no diminution of works, to reward, to no request for their wealth, to a call that they themselves spend.
The focus's وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ answers the possible misreading of expenditure as divine acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated deduction, promised wages, negated request, and then commanded expenditure; I infer a distinction between expropriation for God and release into God's path. A live alternative is that 47:36's negation is rhetorical qualification rather than an accounting contrast.

changed_reading.before: The audience is asked to surrender assets to a superior claimant.
changed_reading.after: The audience is invited into a nonextractive economy: God neither needs their assets nor docks their work, while their refusal alone debits their own needy position.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier تولي is immediately expanded as corruption and cutting kinship. Its recurrence in the focus therefore makes replacement answer a relational and administrative rupture, not merely an individual's refusal to donate.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal and refusal of engagement supply the earlier action whose social consequences are then stated.
Severing connection supplies the concrete relational effect of turning away.
Kinship supplies the living social bond damaged by withdrawal.
Putting another in the vacated place supplies a response to the rupture.
Care, governance, and maintenance supply the positive relational function of the replacement collective.

structural_cues: The conditional إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ in 47:22 reappears as وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا in 47:38.
The earlier occurrence explicitly unfolds from turning away to damage within the collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and an earlier turning-to-severance sequence; I infer that replacement restores a vacated social function. A live alternative is that replacement is purely punitive and carries no reparative arrow.

changed_reading.before: Turning away triggers an external punishment of demographic replacement.
changed_reading.after: Turning away tears the relations and duties by which a people stands, so another people enters the abandoned maintenance role.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah tests some people by others, links mutual aid to stabilized footing, and later tests who strives and endures. The focus replacement can therefore be read as a tested relay of collective agency: a group that will not stand into the task yields the position to another.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes a condition visible supplies the social trial in which groups become evidence about one another.
The second resolved inventory likewise foregrounds examination that reveals the tested party's state.
Parts set against parts supply the reciprocal social medium of the test.
Aid answered by aid supplies the reciprocal action expected of a participating collective.
Strengthening and fixing supplies the result of accepted participation.
Repeated examination near the close makes revealed performance, not nominal membership, the selection pressure.
Rising with resolve toward a task supplies the functional profile of the incoming people.
Standing in another's place supplies the relay between tested collectives.

structural_cues: 47:4 explicitly places some of the audience in relation to others as the medium of trial; 47:31 returns to testing near the focus.
The conditional replacement in 47:38 follows the surah's repeated distinction between professed identity and revealed performance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal testing, aid, stabilization, and final substitution; I infer that failed performance transfers a collective role to another tested bearer. A live alternative is a simpler warning of replacement with no relay structure.

changed_reading.before: Replacement selects a morally better group after the present group fails.
changed_reading.after: Replacement is the next movement in a revealed-performance relay: collective agency remains in circulation even when one bearer withdraws.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier مثْل language turns persons and destroyed predecessors into portable examples whose outcomes can recur. The final لَا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَكُمْ can then negate recurrence itself: replacement interrupts the audience's reproducible pattern, not only its membership.

activation_trace.role: A struck, portable example supplies the surah's early mechanism for making conduct repeatably legible.
The end-result of predecessors supplies the temporal pattern that later actors risk repeating.
An analogue functioning as warning or sign supplies explicit recurrence across groups.
The final negated likeness blocks equivalence between the outgoing and incoming collective.
Imitation supplies the behavioral replication that the final clause may also refuse.

structural_cues: The root م ث ل appears near the opening, at the backward-looking destruction scene, and in the final word-group of the surah.
The final occurrence is uniquely negated and attached to a replacement condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring analogues and predecessor outcomes, followed by negated likeness; I infer an arrow from replacement to interruption of behavioral recurrence. A live alternative is that أَمْثَالَكُمْ only compares the moral qualities of two groups.

changed_reading.before: The replacement people will simply be unlike the present audience.
changed_reading.after: The final clause is anti-recursive: the new bearer is not to become another instance of the same failed model.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding call-language forbids calling toward peace from weakness, affirms the audience's upper hand, and promises no diminution of works. The focus's passive 'you are called' can therefore make expenditure the material mobilization that sustains non-withdrawal, while still allowing broader giving.

activation_trace.role: Calling as inclination toward an objective supplies the lexical counterpart to the focus's passive summons.
Loss of strength and resolve supplies the prohibited condition from which the prior call would arise.
Peace or cessation of conflict supplies the immediate objective toward which they must not incline from weakness.
The promise of no stolen shortfall in their works underwrites continued commitment.
The passive summons redirects call-energy toward expenditure.
Outgoing wealth supplies the material means by which resolve becomes collective action.

structural_cues: 47:35 and 47:38 repeat د ع و with opposed grammatical roles: the audience calls in the first and is called in the second.
Only two ayat separate the warning against weakness from the demand to release resources in the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired call-constructions, weakness, peace, protected works, and expenditure; I infer that spending materially sustains the stance demanded in 47:35. A live alternative is unrestricted charity with no mobilization-specific scope.

changed_reading.before: The focus changes subject from conflict and endurance to a general financial duty.
changed_reading.after: The focus continues the endurance sequence materially: those restrained from a weak call to disengage are themselves summoned to fund continued participation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts flowing provision with temporary enjoyment and consuming intake. Activated by those material images, the focus tunnel/path cluster makes expenditure a circulation regime: possession becomes fruitful by passing onward, whereas closed consumption eventually consumes the holder's own share in the path.

activation_trace.role: Continuous flowing supplies the context's positive movement of provision.
Opening and widening until something flows supplies the channel form of that movement.
Consuming or taking wealth supplies the closed, ingestive alternative to circulation.
Extended but temporary enjoyment supplies the time-limited horizon of retained consumption.
Four repeated channels amplify open, sustained conveyance as a material counter-image.
A passage with an outlet gives the focus expenditure its circulation geometry.
The traveled road directs circulation beyond the possessor.

structural_cues: 47:12 places flowing rivers and repetitive eating in one contrastive scene; 47:15 multiplies the rivers.
The focus joins the outlet-bearing ن ف ق image to a traversable سبيل and opposes both to repeated retention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, channels, temporary enjoyment, consumption, outlet, and path; I infer two rival material regimes, circulation and enclosure. A live alternative is that the river and eating imagery remains eschatological contrast rather than an economic mechanism for 47:38.

changed_reading.before: Spending subtracts from a stock that consumption otherwise preserves for its owner.
changed_reading.after: Spending places provision into a living channel, while withholding traps it in a finite consumption loop whose loss returns to the holder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from finance into respiration and hydraulic form; it remains anchored in نَفْس, the outlet branch of ن ف ق, and the context's opened channels. Render only as a material analogy in which release relieves the self, not as a claim that the ayah lexically equates money with breath.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَبْخَلُ عَن نَفْسِهِ beside تُنفِقُوا and the repeated channel imagery activated from context

activation_trace.role: Breath exiting the interior supplies a bodily image of necessary release.
Relieving constriction supplies the benefit that release returns to the self.
A passage with an exit supplies the conduit through which release occurs.
Repeated opened channels supply the context activator for reading release as sustained flow.

changed_reading.before: Withholding protects the self by keeping substance inside its boundary.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, withholding constricts the self like retained breath, while expenditure opens the outlet through which the self is relieved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because الْفُقَرَاءُ ordinarily names need, not anatomy; it remains anchored in the packet's فَقار branch and is cross-supported by qiwam and stabilized feet. Render as a load-bearing analogy for human dependency and communal replacement, never as a substitute lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ followed by replacement with a قَوْم

activation_trace.role: Articulated vertebrae supply the image of a dependent, load-bearing structure vulnerable to breakage.
Support, framework, and subsistence supply the function by which a collective holds an order upright.
Independent adequacy marks God as not one of the load-dependent members.
Strengthening supplies the context activator for structural support.
Feet that bear and advance the body complete the context's upright structural image.

changed_reading.before: Humans are poor individuals who need divine provision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, humans are articulated supports who stand only through supplied qiwam; failed supports can be replaced without implying any weakness in the structure's divine sustainer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant resolved د ع ع branch beneath د ع و; the packet still anchors it to the focus call and the preceding exhaustive pressure. Render as a force-gradient echo between invitation and hard pushing, not as an assertion that تُدْعَوْنَ literally means violent compulsion.

activation_trace.role: Severe pushing supplies the strange outer edge of force latent in the packet's split mapping of the summons.
Ordinary verbal calling supplies the governing, less coercive center of the focus form.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the immediate context's explicit pressure pole.
Withholding under pressure supplies the behavioral threshold against which the focus summons is heard.

changed_reading.before: The call to spend has a single, neutral degree of demand.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the paired ayat expose a gradient from invitation to exhaustive pressure and ask what degree of summons reveals rather than manufactures withholding.

strongest_changes: Withholding became the inward return of the surah's repeated obstruction from God's path, not merely a private refusal.
The immediate pressure-withholding-disclosure sequence made the focus call a test that reveals latent attachment.
The no-deduction, reward, no-request, then expenditure sequence recast giving as nonextractive and human need as the only deficit.
Replacement became both a tested transfer of communal function and a possible interruption of a reproducible failed pattern.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses the surah's path, work, testing, turning, call, and likeness recurrences into one material decision, while the tripled ب خ ل and the immediate 47:37 conditional expose the self that the decision constructs.
remaining_uncertainties: The outlet, breath, channel, and vertebral readings are materially coherent but remain analogical rather than secure lexical senses in this construction.
Replacement may be reparative functional succession, punitive succession, or both without the focus resolving the relation.
The immediate mobilization context may narrow expenditure toward sustaining collective struggle, but the focus wording can still carry broader expenditure in God's path.
The split د ع و to د ع ع activation is worth preserving only as a qualified pressure echo.
